column1: # CTRMap-F5 building/decoration catalog (ORAS) - METADATA ONLY; geometry is cut
# from the user's own pristine dump at placement time (MapPrefab.extract).
# Mined + render-verified from the retail maps (every box proven by extracting,
# stamping onto painted grass and inspecting the offscreen render).
# Columns: kind name donorRegion donorArea tx0 ty0 tx1 ty1 baseY doorDX doorDY doorProp interiorZone interiorWarpId
#  - box = region-local tiles (inclusive) in FieldData entry donorRegion
#  - baseY = the building's floor Y in the donor region; stamp dy = targetGroundY - baseY
#  - doorDX/DY = the enter tile relative to the box anchor (-1 = not enterable)
#  - doorProp = the animated door prop's model (placed separately via the Prop Tool)
#  - interiorZone/WarpId = the retail interior behind the door (entry warp is always 0)
